title: Sort cards: boy and girl words
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Special days, summer and numbers
source: Written for arabic/y3 lesson 4 (Sort cards: boy and girl words (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 4: Bridge: boy words, girl words and my. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

blocks.title: Sort into: Boy word (masculine) / Girl word (feminine)
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Boy word (masculine), Girl word (feminine).
blocks.answer: Boy word (masculine): كِتَابٌ (kitab) book; قَلَمٌ (qalam) pen; بَابٌ (bab) door. Girl word (feminine): حَقِيبَةٌ (haqibah) bag; مَدْرَسَةٌ (madrasah) school; سَيَّارَةٌ (sayyarah) car

panels.title: This for girl words
points: هٰذَا كِتَابٌ (hadha kitabun) this is a book
هٰذِهِ حَقِيبَةٌ (hadhihi haqibatun) this is a bag

head: Not this
This
rows: حَقِيبَتِي (haqibati): ة becomes ت before ـِي

keywords.def: the round ta at the end of most girl words

questions.q: Core: Copy and finish with هٰذَا or هٰذِهِ: ___ بَابٌ / ___ مَدْرَسَةٌ / ___ قَلَمٌ / ___ سَيَّارَةٌ
questions.a: هٰذَا بَابٌ / هٰذِهِ مَدْرَسَةٌ / هٰذَا قَلَمٌ / هٰذِهِ سَيَّارَةٌ

questions.q: Extend: Write 'my' for: كِتَابٌ، حَقِيبَةٌ، مَدْرَسَةٌ
Stretch: Write one sentence: هٰذِهِ ... with 'my', e.g. this is my bag.

questions.a: B) حَقِيبَتِي. حَقِيبَتِي: the ة of حَقِيبَةٌ becomes ت and ـِي (my) is added.

questions.q: Which word is a girl word? A) قَلَمٌ B) مَدْرَسَةٌ C) بَابٌ
Big question: how can I tell if an Arabic word is a girl word?
questions.a: It usually ends in ة (ta marbutah).
